Every dictation made with the owner's Super+Alt+D toggle is cleaned by a small local CPU model (S1-mini by Superwhisper) before it lands in the clipboard, with no server or service the owner has to install, start or maintain. The model is loaded only when a dictation needs it and is unloaded after Handy's existing idle timeout, so it holds no memory when unused.

Quill or any second model entry; per-shortcut presets; streaming output; GPU/Vulkan inference; linking llama.cpp into the Handy process; changes to speech transcription; upstream PR.

Binary location: `/usr/lib/Handy/llm/llama-server` (not `/usr/bin`, to avoid clashing with Fedora's `llama-cpp` package). Resolution order: env `HANDY_LLAMA_SERVER` (dev only), then `/usr/lib/Handy/llm/llama-server`. A missing binary is a `LocalLlmError::BinaryMissing`, never a panic. It is built statically (`-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF`, CPU backend only) so it shares no libraries with Handy's bundled ggml.

`ModelEntry { id, display_name, attribution, card_url, backend: BackendKind::LlamaServer, file_name, url (Hugging Face resolve URL at a pinned commit revision), sha256, size_bytes, prompt_style: PromptStyle, default_ctx: u32 }`.

v1 entry: `s1-mini-q4km`, "S1-mini by Superwhisper", file `s1-mini-q4_k_m.gguf` from `superwhisper/s1-mini-GGUF` at a pinned revision, size 484,219,808 bytes, sha256 from the Hugging Face LFS oid (the planner records the exact revision and hash after re-verifying them), `PromptStyle::S1ControlLine`, context 4096.

Request: `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `messages`, `temperature: 0`, `stream: false`, `max_tokens = min(2 * est_tokens(input) + 64, ctx / 2)`, `chat_template_kwargs: {"enable_thinking": false}`, bearer API key. A dedicated `reqwest` client with timeout `10 s + 50 ms * input_words`.

Chunking: if the estimated prompt exceeds 1000 tokens (card limit per pass), split the transcript at sentence boundaries into chunks under the limit, process them in order, join with a single space.

Output guards, in order (any failure returns an error, so the raw transcript is used): strip think blocks and invisible characters (existing helpers); empty output is accepted only when the input has at most 3 words; output with fewer than 50% of the input's words is rejected with a warning.

Shown in post-processing settings when provider is "Local (in-app)": model dropdown (registry), Download / Delete button with progress, status label (Not loaded / Loading / Ready / Error with reason), the three S1 dropdowns (only for `S1ControlLine`), attribution link. English strings only.

`LocalLlmError { BinaryMissing, ModelMissing, ModelCorrupt, StartTimeout, StartFailed, RequestTimeout, Http(status), BadOutput(reason), Failed }`. Every variant is logged at warn with its reason and maps to the raw transcript. No new work on the main thread. No `unwrap`/`expect` in non-test code.

Each guard in 4 and each lifecycle rule in 6 gets a counterfactual: disable only that guard, show the test failing, restore.

Integration test (ignored by default, enabled with `HANDY_LOCAL_LLM_IT=1`, needs the model file and `llama-server`): spawns the real server, runs 3 synthetic transcripts, asserts outputs equal golden files (greedy decoding is deterministic), asserts the child is gone after `unload()`.

Acceptance on the installed RPM (added to `build/gate.sh` as check 6, owner runs it): after one Super+Alt+D dictation the Handy log shows a local-LLM success line and the clipboard holds the cleaned text; with `model_unload_timeout` set to 2 minutes, no `llama-server` process exists 2 minutes after the last dictation; with the model file removed, a dictation still yields the raw transcript.

Make post-processing a first-class, visible part of daily use: both shortcuts in one place, the local cleanup model managed and switched like the transcription model, and every history entry showing whether it was cleaned and what changed.

Transcription models were checked for per-model settings: none exist. Language, translation, custom words, accelerator, GPU device and unload timeout are app-wide (`src-tauri/src/settings.rs:434-535`), so no transcription-model settings page is needed.

Tabs on the Models page; moving the enable switch; Quill or other models; release pipeline, updater endpoint or signing; translations beyond English for new strings (other locales fall back or keep existing labels); upstream PRs.

Current state: General's first group renders the transcribe shortcut, `ShortcutActivationSetting`, then cancel (hidden on Linux) (`src/components/settings/general/GeneralSettings.tsx:16-42`). The post-process shortcut sits on the post-processing page (`src/components/settings/post-processing/PostProcessingSettings.tsx:449-453`). Bindings cannot be cleared: the inputs commit only non-empty captures and offer Reset, not Clear (`src/components/settings/GlobalShortcutInput.tsx:80,294`, `src/components/settings/HandyKeysShortcutInput.tsx:153,342`); `change_binding` rejects empty strings (`src-tauri/src/shortcut/mod.rs:118`) and so do both validators (`shortcut/tauri_impl.rs:45`, `shortcut/handy_keys.rs:414`). Duplicate detection is registration-based only, and because capture suspends other registrations a duplicate can be saved; on resume one of the two silently stays inactive in HashMap order (`shortcut/mod.rs:187,252`).

Current state: groups Hotkey, API, Prompts; the local LLM UI is nested inside API after provider selection (`PostProcessingSettings.tsx:30-149,435-470`); the group title is `API (OpenAI compatible)` even for the local provider.

Design: a new `LocalLlmModelSelector` next to it, rendered only when `post_process_enabled` and the provider is `local_llm`. Button: status dot plus selected model's `display_name` (truncated like the existing button). Dropdown: downloaded local models, the selected one marked Active; choosing one calls `setLocalLlmModel(id)` then `refreshSettings()` (pattern at `LocalLlmSettings.tsx:98`). Status from `getLocalLlmStatus()` plus `local-llm-state-changed` (`LocalLlmSettings.tsx:75`). If no local model is downloaded, the button reads `No cleanup model` and opens the post-processing page. Selecting does not load the model (existing lazy behaviour).

Current state: `build_menu` from a `MenuInputs` snapshot, single native writer, rebuild on snapshot change (`src-tauri/src/tray.rs:57,230-370,458-565`); Unload Model handled in `lib.rs:308`; tray labels come from locale JSON with empty strings for missing keys (`src-tauri/build.rs:316,344`).

Current state: entries render `transcription_text` only and copy it (`src/components/settings/history/HistorySettings.tsx:254,435-439`); `HistoryEntry` already carries `post_processed_text`, `post_process_prompt`, `post_process_requested` (`src/bindings.ts:1082`); no provider/model provenance is stored (`src-tauri/src/managers/history.rs:20-66`); only single-entry delete exists (`commands/history.rs:51`), with a private multi-delete helper for retention (`managers/history.rs:350`).

Every new command returns `Result<_, String>` shown through the page's existing error line; no `unwrap`/`expect` outside tests; no new main-thread blocking (tray unload and manager calls run on std threads or `spawn_blocking`); clearing the last transcribe binding and duplicate keys are refused, never half-applied.

Rust unit tests: duplicate detection across all bindings including a suspended one; `clear_binding` refusals and success; empty binding skipped at registration; `clear_history(keep_saved)` keeps starred rows and removes others plus files; provenance columns written and read, old rows null; `history_compare_view` default and old-store deserialization; tray `MenuInputs` includes local status and the unload item's enabled state per state. Each guard gets a counterfactual.

Manual acceptance on the installed RPM: General shows both shortcuts when post-processing is enabled; a duplicate key is refused; Raw can be cleared and Clean still works; post-processing page shows Provider then Local model with the model list; footer picker switches the model; tray shows cleanup status and unloads it; a cleaned dictation shows Diff/Side by side/Stacked and the choice persists; Clear History keeps starred entries; gate.sh passes with the env var absent.

Same as the local LLM series: implement on `local/llm-postprocess`, export with `build/rebase-patches.sh`, build with `build/build.sh`, install with `build/install.sh`, check with `build/gate.sh`.

Make the v2 UI read cleanly and consistently: one term for the second stage everywhere, nothing truncated, symmetric controls for the transcription model and the post-processing model (sidebar, footer, tray), history actions in one row, and a real choice of local post-processing models.

Acceptance check: `rg -i '\bclean(ed|up)?\b'` over the values of `src/i18n/locales/en/translation.json` that this branch added or changed returns nothing (upstream's own strings are left alone).

Labels are truncated ("Transcriptio...", "Post-proces..."). Widen the sidebar so the longest English label ("Transcription Models", "Post-processing Models") fits at the default font size, and allow a label to wrap to a second line rather than truncate if it still does not fit (other locales, larger fonts). No drag-to-resize. Verify at Handy's minimum window size.

The planner verifies exact repo ids, file names, revisions, hashes, sizes and licences from the Hugging Face API and records them; any entry whose licence is not Apache-2.0-compatible is flagged to the owner instead of added.
